Position Title

Director, People Analytics

Status Of Employment

Permanent

Position Language Requirement

English, French

Language Skills

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date

2026-10-03 11:59 PM

Reporting to the Executive Director, People Systems & Analytics the Director, People Analytics will own the vision, creation, and deployment of the enterprise-wide People Analytics strategy for CBC/Radio-Canada.

As a key strategic partner to executive leadership across the corporation, you will champion a data-driven culture, turning complex workforce data into actionable business intelligence that shapes our talent strategy and drives organizational performance. You will lead the maturation of our analytics function from descriptive reporting to predictive modeling, maximizing our investment in Workday to drive leader self-service while enforcing the highest standards of data governance and privacy.

Leading and scaling a dedicated team of Managers and Analytics Specialists, you will cultivate a team capable of diagnosing complex organizational needs and translating data into compelling, executive-level narratives that drive change.

Location: This is a bilingual position (English/French) and can be based in either Ottawa or Toronto with flexible hybrid work options.

Key Responsibilities And Projects

Strategic Leadership & Vision

Own the Strategy: Develop, champion, and execute the multi-year People Analytics roadmap aligned with CBC/Radio-Canada’s overarching business and talent goals.
Executive Partnership: Act as the primary trusted advisor to business leaders and P&C executives, translating workforce trends, attrition models, and engagement data into high-impact business strategies.
Data Demoralization: Drive the adoption of leader self-service models to put data directly into the hands of decision-makers.

Data Governance & Ecosystem Management

Enterprise Governance: Architect and enforce strict data governance, data security, and privacy frameworks across all HR data systems, ensuring compliance with federal and internal privacy regulations.
Cross-Functional Integration: Partner with IT, Finance, and Corporate Research to break down data silos, integrating HR data with financial and operational KPIs to measure true business impact.

Scope Of Impact

Enterprise-wide People Analytics strategy

Decision Making Authority

Define and lead the direction of the People Analytics program to meet the overall People & Culture strategy

Relationships

This role would have to interact with all COE’s within People & Culture as well as key clients within other components, particularly, Finance, T&I, Media Lines
Exposure to SET members, unions and other key stakeholders as required

Leadership

Foster a team culture of coaching and guiding process owners on the optimal, effective usage of Workday and other HR solutions to gain the most out of our technology by proactively recommending solutions to solve business needs or support their strategy.
People Leadership: Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of data analysts and translators, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and consultative service excellence.
Advanced Storytelling: Oversee the design and evolution of enterprise HR dashboards and executive presentations, ensuring the team excels at "storytelling through data" to influence organizational health metrics.

Qualifications, Experience And Skills

Education: University degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Science, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related quantitative field (Master’s degree or MBA preferred).
Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or HR strategy, with at least 10+ years in a distinct leadership role managing analytics teams within a complex, matrixed, or public-sector organization.
Platform Expertise: Proven experience leveraging enterprise HRIS platforms (Workday experience required) alongside advanced business intelligence tools (e.g., PowerBI, Data warehouse, data lakes, etc).
Language: Fully bilingual in English and French (written and spoken) is required.

Technical & Leadership Competencies

Strategic Problem Solving & Decision Making: Demonstrates the ability to navigate ambiguity and diagnose complex, systemic organizational challenges. Anticipates potential roadblocks, evaluates risks, and collaborates across functional boundaries to implement sustainable, data-driven solutions that align with long-term business goals.
Predictive & Statistical Acumen: Strong foundational knowledge of statistical methods (e.g., regression analysis, forecasting, workforce modeling) and how to apply them to talent acquisition, retention, and diversity initiatives.
Data Governance Champion: Demonstrated experience building data governance frameworks, data dictionaries, and security protocols from scratch.
Executive Presence & Storytelling: Exceptional capability to connect abstract data points to concrete business outcomes, delivering compelling presentations to C-suite and Board-level stakeholders.

Working Conditions

Typical schedule: Standard
Remote work: Available
Travel requirements: Occasional

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:

A mandatory Criminal record check.
Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Finance Agriculture
jobs.description:
Job Description

Please note:

The ideal candidate has experience supporting and/or is specialized in Agribusiness/Agriculture
As this role supports the Southwestern Ontario Market, there is flexibility in the work location within this market

What is the opportunity?

As Director, Commercial Finance, you are part of a team of client-facing credit professionals aligned to our Large Agriculture client segment. You play a key role in realizing our business growth objectives through the structuring, delivery and management of credit for a portfolio of large commercial agriculture clients. You will lead the end-to-end credit relationship for a defined portfolio of clients with a focus on loan origination and ongoing portfolio quality oversight. You contribute to an exceptional client experience by providing superior business, financial and credit advice directly to clients.

Mobility

This role supports the Southwestern Ontario Market, offering flexibility in work location within this geographic region.

What will you do?

Collaborate with client relationship managers to structure, deliver, close, and monitor loan transactions, including credit submissions to Group Risk Management (GRM) and transaction presentations to clients
Collaborate with client relationship managers in the preparation and presentation of credit pitches that clearly articulate advantages and benefits of proposed credit solutions to existing and potential clients
Demonstrate RBC’s capability to provide customized and creative credit solutions in a timely manner and deliver credit solutions that meet or exceed our client’s needs
Manage all aspects of the credit approval process including Commitments Committee and GRM, developing strong working relationships with National Office personnel and risk managers
Actively develop, strengthen and deepen client relationships and engage with key RBC partners including Group Risk Management, Private Banking, Corporate Client Group (including the Asset Based Lending, Mid-Market Leverage Finance and Mezzanine Finance teams), Transaction Banking, Personal Banking, and others
Exercise due diligence in recommending credit applications, working in collaboration with Risk Management, especially in supporting risk processes and guidelines in order to find the appropriate mix of credit risk and structural mitigants.
Maintain portfolio quality oversight through proactive portfolio management, including annual credit renewals, covenant monitoring and control

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

Proven track record in financial and credit analysis in support of exceptional client relationship management
Minimum five years’ experience in commercial lending at a major financial institution
Experience supporting and/or specialized in Agribusiness/Agriculture
Undergraduate degree in Business, Economics, Accounting, or Finance with strong quantitative, financial modeling, and analytical skills, as well as an ability to analyze company financial statements
Strong skills with Microsoft Office, as well as experience with emerging resources, communications and technology (e.g. online data resources, web-based meetings, social media, digital banking, and mobile applications)
Professional verbal and written communication skills with a high level of attention to detail in both written work and financial analysis
Strong organizational skills, ability to perform well under pressure, prioritize multiple tasks and projects, while meeting time-sensitive deadlines

Nice-to-have

MBA, CPA or CFA
Work experience in corporate lending/corporate finance
Trained in credit and accounting with an ability to manage complex concepts

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
Opportunities to do challenging work

Job Skills

Agricultural Lending, Agriculture Banking, Agriculture Industry, Commercial Banking Relationship Management, Commercial Credit Underwriting, Financial Analysis

jobs.description:
Position Title

Director, AI Governance and Adoption (T & I) (Telework/Hybrid)

Status Of Employment

Permanent

Position Language Requirement

English, French

Language Skills

English (Reading - C - Advanced), English (Speaking - C - Advanced), English (Writing - B - Intermediate), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - B - Intermediate)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date

2026-09-28 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

This position can be based in Montreal, Toronto or Ottawa.

Your Role

The Director, AI Governance and Adoption is responsible for driving the evolution of the enterprise AI governance framework, and facilitating the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence technologies across the organization. Acting as a strategic partner to executives and business teams, this individual supports the identification of opportunities, the integration of value-creating solutions and the development of an AI-literate culture. The incumbent also oversees the development of the practices, policies and governance mechanisms required to ensure the responsible and sustainable use of artificial intelligence technologies.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Policy & Risk Management

Define and enforce corporate AI policies, directives, and guardrails across all business units.
Operationalize risk controls and decision accountabilities across the entire AI lifecycle (procurement, data retrieval, tool actions, and human oversight).
Build and maintain a central inventory of all internal and third-party AI assets to track systemic risk.

Shadow AI & Secure Experimentation

Audit unsanctioned AI tools ("shadow AI") across departments and facilitate the transition of use cases into secure enterprise environments.
Partner with tech teams to set safety guardrails for low-code/no-code tools, allowing employees to experiment safely.

Leadership, Committees & Alignment

Lead the AI Usage Oversight Committee and coordinate the enterprise AI Steering Committee.
Align AI initiatives with Legal, Privacy, InfoSec, Data Governance, and Journalistic Standards to ensure regulatory compliance.

Adoption, Enablement & Literacy

Develop training programs, playbooks, office hours, and champion networks to boost organization-wide AI literacy.
Help business units integrate deployed AI solutions into their everyday production workflows.

Workflow Re-Engineering & Value Tracking

Direct a cross-functional "Fusion Team" to help management re-engineer legacy workflows for native AI integration.
Define, track, and report performance and governance metrics to prove ROI and accountability.

Vendor Management & Industry Representation

Advise Procurement and Legal on standards for evaluating and onboarding third-party AI vendors.
Represent the organization (CBC/Radio-Canada) at national and international conferences, contributing to public media data provenance standards.

Internal Governance & Executive Alignment

Senior Advisory: Advise executives on AI strategy, run governance committees, and deliver executive leadership-level briefings when required.
Standards & Training: Roll out AI policies across all departments (Media, Tech, Business) and partner with L&D on staff training and literacy initiatives.

AI Adoption & Change Management

Fusion Team Leadership: Stand up and lead a cross-functional team of change management, training, and process optimization specialists.
Workflow Integration: Work with department heads and staff to resolve workflow pain points and drive adoption of approved AI tools.
Tracking & Reporting: Partner with Innovation Leads to establish ROI metrics and report adoption progress, blockers, and learnings to leadership.

External Relations & Industry Networks

Industry and Peer Collaboration: Partner with media organizations, industry groups (EBU, INMA), and analysts (Gartner) to benchmark best practices.
Thought Leadership: Share CBC/RC case studies and governance frameworks with external and public stakeholders.

What You Bring

Qualifications, experience & skills

7+ years of technology leadership experience, with 3 years of supervisory experience required.
At least 5 years explicitly focused on operationalizing data or technology strategy, machine learning, technology risk management, or corporate governance programs.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required. A degree in Information Technology, Computer Systems Analysis, Engineering, or Management Information Systems is preferred.
Bilingualism (English and French).
Enterprise AI Governance: Proven track record building and managing AI oversight programs, governing models and agentic workflows, and developing policies, audits, and control documentation.
Strategy-to-Operations: Ability to turn high-level strategy into actionable standards, operational workflows, and scalable operating models.
Enterprise Change & Adoption: Demonstrated success scaling technology adoption across matrixed, multi-stakeholder organizations.
AI & Data Expertise: Deep knowledge of AI lifecycles, generative/agentic risks, data privacy, and public media compliance standards.
Executive Leadership: Exceptional communication skills to translate complex AI concepts and risks into business impact for executive and board-level stakeholders.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

jobs.title: Vice President, Commercial Financial Services –  Downtown Vancouver and Media & Entertainment
jobs.description:
Job Description

As the Vice President, Commercial Financial Services – Downtown Vancouver and Media & Entertainment, you inspire, motivate and engage your sales team to deliver a highly differentiated client experience to enhance client loyalty and grow revenue by acquiring new clients and deepening existing client relationships. You will focus on coaching your team to high standards of behaviors, activities and results. Collaborating with other RBC colleagues across the organization, you will contribute to helping RBC maintain its dominant market position.

At RBC, we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity to build trust with every interaction and Doing What’s Right for our clients. Adherence to RBC’s Code of Conduct and our Values will guide us and set expectations for ethical behaviors and decision making. They help us decide how we serve our clients and deal with each other with respect, transparency and fairness.

What will you do?

Provide leadership, direction and ongoing coaching to the Relationship Managers Commercial Banking team, building employee engagement through focused sales routines
Lead and advocate change within the organization by building engagement and inspiring your team to achieve the desired business outcomes
Demonstrate your market leadership by promoting the RBC brand and enhancing visibility by developing and maintaining a network in the business community, working closely with industry and business leaders, community groups and RBC partners
Manage the business to achieve market and sales objectives through focus and dedication to effective sales management routines that add value for the team while balancing both operational and credit risk requirements
Leverage full RBC capabilities including branches, alternate delivery channels and service partners to achieve RBC’s business goals
Employ digital channels, drive client awareness, and ensure your team is enabling clients with RBC digital access

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have:

Minimum 5-7 years commercial banking experience preferred
Proven track record in leading and coaching professional sales teams to high standards of performance
Actively foster continuous learning mindset and professional development of team members as well as model own commitment to development by actively growing, developing and learning as a leader and coach
Astute business acumen with strong knowledge of financial industry and commercial banking
Strong knowledge of credit management, product and pricing policies, privacy, code of conduct and anti-money laundering requirements, and overall business center operations.
Strong sales orientation and a demonstrated passion for putting clients first

Nice-to-have:

Industry experience supporting Diversified, Mining and Media & Entertainment clients
Proven leadership, sales management and performance management skills
Strong communication and presentation skills
A post-secondary diploma/degree, ideally in Commerce, Business Administration, MBA or related experience is required.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits and competitive compensation
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities

jobs.title: Director, Strategy and Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Req Id:
432851

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary

Bell AI Fabric is building Canada's largest sovereign AI infrastructure platform. As Director, Strategic Finance & Corporate Development, you will work at the centre of Bell AI Fabric's most important investment, capital allocation, commercial, and growth decisions, providing the financial insight and execution discipline required to scale the business.

This is a highly visible, hands-on finance role with unusual breadth and access. Working directly with senior executives, the Bell AI Fabric Board, Bell Finance leadership, and business teams, you will lead business cases, financial modelling, capital planning, performance analysis, and finance support for major customer, partnership, and infrastructure opportunities.

You will turn complex operational, commercial, tax, and accounting inputs into clear financial conclusions and decision-ready materials. You will also manage and develop team members, set priorities, review work closely, and raise the quality, precision, and pace of the team's output.

This is a unique opportunity for a finance, consulting, investment banking, or corporate development professional who wants to help build something consequential and expand their responsibilities quickly. You do not need to arrive knowing every aspect of the business. Success will come from curiosity, sound judgment, humility, exceptional care in the work, and a willingness to invest the effort required to learn and figure things out.

Key Responsibilities

Act as a trusted strategic finance partner to the executive team, leading the financial analysis behind Bell AI Fabric's highest-priority investments, commercial opportunities, and growth initiatives.
Build, maintain, and drive integrated financial models, business cases, forecasts, sensitivities, and decision tools that connect customer demand, pricing, capacity, capital requirements, operating costs, tax, accounting, and expected returns.
Lead monthly and quarterly capital allocation processes, assess competing requirements, challenge assumptions, and recommend how capital should be prioritized across projects and opportunities.
Question business stakeholders constructively and use judgment to reconcile commercial ambition, financial discipline, operational realities, risk, and timing into the best overall financial decision.
Support major customer opportunities, partnerships, financing initiatives, and transactions through rigorous economics, scenario analysis, financial diligence, and executive recommendations, while partnering with the deal lead on negotiations and structuring.
Work closely with Tax, Accounting, Treasury, FP&A, Corporate Development, and project teams to ensure financial conclusions reflect the appropriate treatment, assumptions, controls, and enterprise requirements.
Translate financial priorities into executable workplans with clear outputs, owners, milestones, dependencies, review points, and escalation paths; drive workstreams through completion.
Identify and improve financial processes, governance, model controls, reporting, and decision-support capabilities as Bell AI Fabric scales.

Critical Qualifications

Typically 6-10 years of experience in strategic finance, corporate development, investment banking, management consulting, FP&A, project finance, accounting, or another environment that develops comparable financial and execution capabilities.
Strong financial modelling capability, including experience building integrated models, business cases, forecasts, sensitivities, and scenario analyses that support significant decisions.
Demonstrated ability to review complex models and analyses with precision, identify errors or unsupported assumptions, and improve the quality and clarity of the underlying work.
Strong PowerPoint, executive communication, and financial storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clean, decision-oriented materials for senior executives and the Bell AI Fabric Board.
Sound financial and commercial judgment, with the confidence to question stakeholders, pressure-test assumptions, and recommend a practical path forward.
Working knowledge of tax, accounting, and financial reporting considerations, and the ability to partner effectively with subject-matter experts.
Experience managing or developing others, setting clear expectations, reviewing work closely, and maintaining accountability without creating unnecessary hierarchy.
High capacity and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly across multiple urgent priorities without compromising accuracy or quality.
Ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, learn unfamiliar topics quickly, and invest additional effort during critical periods to reach a well-supported answer.

Preferred Qualifications

CPA, CFA, or equivalent financial designations or advanced finance training; candidates with strong equivalent experience are also encouraged to apply.
Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, investments, partnerships, due diligence, valuation, integration planning, or other transaction-related work.
Experience in infrastructure, technology, telecommunications, energy, data centres, project finance, or another capital-intensive industry.
Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, with disciplined model structure, documentation, version control, and quality assurance.
Strong curiosity and a demonstrated ability to become credible quickly on unfamiliar commercial, technical, tax, and accounting topics.
A practical, collaborative, and low-ego working style, including comfort receiving challenge, changing course when the facts require it, and sharing credit with the team.
High standards for pace, precision, ownership, accountability, and follow-through, combined with a genuine interest in difficult problems and continuous learning.

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.

Management

Please apply directly online to be considered for this role. Applications through email will not be accepted.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
***Start-up co-founder position*** Equity only position until revenue milestones hit! Applicants located in North America only. GTA, Ontario preferable.
Company Description
Clash Nexus AI helps construction teams identify drawing issues before they turn into rework, RFIs, delays, or change orders. By uploading construction drawings, specifications, and project documents, users receive AI-driven reviews that flag coordination issues, missing information, scope gaps, spec conflicts, code concerns, and constructability risks. Each finding includes visual evidence, clear context, severity, impact, and recommended next steps, enabling faster, more informed decisions. The platform supports contractors, consultants, engineers, and preconstruction teams in keeping projects on track and reducing costly on-site problems.
Role Description
To begin with, you will bein the trenches coding with Python and working side by side our CEO on product development. The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will become a full-time, remote leadership role responsible for defining and executing the overall technology vision at Clash Nexus AI. This role oversees end-to-end software development, technical architecture, and product engineering for the AI-driven construction review platform. The CTO collaborates closely with product, operations, and customer-facing teams to align technology initiatives with business goals and market needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading and mentoring engineering teams, setting coding standards and best practices, managing technical roadmaps, and ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable systems. The CTO also evaluates new technologies, manages vendor and partner relationships, and contributes to strategic planning, budgeting, and risk management to support sustainable growth.
Qualifications

Strong background in Software Development and Architecture, including experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performance platforms.
Proven expertise in Product Development, guiding features from concept to launch and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability in IT Strategy and Project Management, with experience setting technical roadmaps, priorities, and delivery timelines.
Experience leading remote engineering teams, including mentoring, hiring, and performance management.
Familiarity with AI/ML-driven products or data-intensive systems, ideally in B2B SaaS environments.
Knowledge of construction, engineering, or related industries is a plus, but not required.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

new_jobs.title: Director, Commercial Finance Agriculture
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Please note:

The ideal candidate has experience supporting and/or is specialized in Agribusiness/Agriculture
As this role supports the Southwestern Ontario Market, there is flexibility in the work location within this market

What is the opportunity?

As Director, Commercial Finance, you are part of a team of client-facing credit professionals aligned to our Large Agriculture client segment. You play a key role in realizing our business growth objectives through the structuring, delivery and management of credit for a portfolio of large commercial agriculture clients. You will lead the end-to-end credit relationship for a defined portfolio of clients with a focus on loan origination and ongoing portfolio quality oversight. You contribute to an exceptional client experience by providing superior business, financial and credit advice directly to clients.

Mobility

This role supports the Southwestern Ontario Market, offering flexibility in work location within this geographic region.

What will you do?

Collaborate with client relationship managers to structure, deliver, close, and monitor loan transactions, including credit submissions to Group Risk Management (GRM) and transaction presentations to clients
Collaborate with client relationship managers in the preparation and presentation of credit pitches that clearly articulate advantages and benefits of proposed credit solutions to existing and potential clients
Demonstrate RBC’s capability to provide customized and creative credit solutions in a timely manner and deliver credit solutions that meet or exceed our client’s needs
Manage all aspects of the credit approval process including Commitments Committee and GRM, developing strong working relationships with National Office personnel and risk managers
Actively develop, strengthen and deepen client relationships and engage with key RBC partners including Group Risk Management, Private Banking, Corporate Client Group (including the Asset Based Lending, Mid-Market Leverage Finance and Mezzanine Finance teams), Transaction Banking, Personal Banking, and others
Exercise due diligence in recommending credit applications, working in collaboration with Risk Management, especially in supporting risk processes and guidelines in order to find the appropriate mix of credit risk and structural mitigants.
Maintain portfolio quality oversight through proactive portfolio management, including annual credit renewals, covenant monitoring and control

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

Proven track record in financial and credit analysis in support of exceptional client relationship management
Minimum five years’ experience in commercial lending at a major financial institution
Experience supporting and/or specialized in Agribusiness/Agriculture
Undergraduate degree in Business, Economics, Accounting, or Finance with strong quantitative, financial modeling, and analytical skills, as well as an ability to analyze company financial statements
Strong skills with Microsoft Office, as well as experience with emerging resources, communications and technology (e.g. online data resources, web-based meetings, social media, digital banking, and mobile applications)
Professional verbal and written communication skills with a high level of attention to detail in both written work and financial analysis
Strong organizational skills, ability to perform well under pressure, prioritize multiple tasks and projects, while meeting time-sensitive deadlines

Nice-to-have

MBA, CPA or CFA
Work experience in corporate lending/corporate finance
Trained in credit and accounting with an ability to manage complex concepts

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
Opportunities to do challenging work

Agricultural Lending, Agriculture Banking, Agriculture Industry, Commercial Banking Relationship Management, Commercial Credit Underwriting, Financial Analysis

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

As the Vice President, Commercial Financial Services – Downtown Vancouver and Media & Entertainment, you inspire, motivate and engage your sales team to deliver a highly differentiated client experience to enhance client loyalty and grow revenue by acquiring new clients and deepening existing client relationships. You will focus on coaching your team to high standards of behaviors, activities and results. Collaborating with other RBC colleagues across the organization, you will contribute to helping RBC maintain its dominant market position.

At RBC, we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity to build trust with every interaction and Doing What’s Right for our clients. Adherence to RBC’s Code of Conduct and our Values will guide us and set expectations for ethical behaviors and decision making. They help us decide how we serve our clients and deal with each other with respect, transparency and fairness.

What will you do?

Provide leadership, direction and ongoing coaching to the Relationship Managers Commercial Banking team, building employee engagement through focused sales routines
Lead and advocate change within the organization by building engagement and inspiring your team to achieve the desired business outcomes
Demonstrate your market leadership by promoting the RBC brand and enhancing visibility by developing and maintaining a network in the business community, working closely with industry and business leaders, community groups and RBC partners
Manage the business to achieve market and sales objectives through focus and dedication to effective sales management routines that add value for the team while balancing both operational and credit risk requirements
Leverage full RBC capabilities including branches, alternate delivery channels and service partners to achieve RBC’s business goals
Employ digital channels, drive client awareness, and ensure your team is enabling clients with RBC digital access

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have:

Minimum 5-7 years commercial banking experience preferred
Proven track record in leading and coaching professional sales teams to high standards of performance
Actively foster continuous learning mindset and professional development of team members as well as model own commitment to development by actively growing, developing and learning as a leader and coach
Astute business acumen with strong knowledge of financial industry and commercial banking
Strong knowledge of credit management, product and pricing policies, privacy, code of conduct and anti-money laundering requirements, and overall business center operations.
Strong sales orientation and a demonstrated passion for putting clients first

Nice-to-have:

Industry experience supporting Diversified, Mining and Media & Entertainment clients
Proven leadership, sales management and performance management skills
Strong communication and presentation skills
A post-secondary diploma/degree, ideally in Commerce, Business Administration, MBA or related experience is required.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits and competitive compensation
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
A collaborative dynamic culture where personal initiative and hard work are recognized and rewarded

Director of Finance

Abbotsford, BC | Onsite

$130,000–$150,000

Our client is looking for an experienced Finance professional to lead the modernization and continuous improvement of their Finance function.
Reporting to the CFO
, this is a hands-on senior leadership role for someone who combines strong accounting and financial management expertise with a passion for technology, automation, process improvement, and building high-performing teams
.
You’ll have the opportunity to shape how Finance operates, improve systems and processes, and partner with business leaders to drive better financial decision-making.

What You'll Do

Lead Finance transformation, process improvement, and automation initiatives.
Identify opportunities to leverage AI, technology, and automation
to improve Finance efficiency.
Lead the optimization of ERP and Finance systems, including enhancements and implementation projects.
Oversee financial management for designated business units and partner with operational leaders.
Support month-end close, financial reporting, cash management, and internal controls.
Lead and develop Finance team members, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Partner with the CFO, Controller, Technology, Operations, and other leaders on strategic initiatives.
Provide hands-on leadership across both day-to-day Finance operations and longer-term transformation projects.

What You'll Bring

5+ years of progressive Finance/Accounting experience.

CPA designation or equivalent experience preferred.
Strong understanding of accounting, financial reporting, and internal controls.
Proven experience with Finance transformation, ERP systems, automation, or process improvement
.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and communication skills.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach.
Experience leading, coaching, and developing team members.
Experience with AI, automation, BI, or other Finance technologies is an asset.
Manufacturing or distribution experience is an asset.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to make a real impact on the future of Finance
. You’ll have the autonomy to identify opportunities, implement improvements, modernize systems, and help build a more efficient and scalable Finance function.
If you're a Finance leader who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, embracing technology, and making things better
, we'd love to hear from you.
